title: potentilla argentea subvar. tenerrima
intro: Potentilla argentea subvar. tenerrima, commonly known as Silver-leaved Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, providing potential health benefits such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla argentea subvar. tenerrima are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. Research has identified the presence of salicylic acid and other bioactive compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
